name: fairclinic-controlled-drugs
description: Fairclinic Controlled Drugs: reconciles a veterinary controlled drug log (DEA schedule items) with the physical count: the balance worked out from the entries against the written balance and the count, arithmetic errors that hide a difference, waste with no witness, use with no patient, entries with no initials. It reports the log; it never decides compliance or files anything. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.
